name: PubPerf Analytics
author: Transfon

sections.description:
PubPerf is analytics for publishers who earn from ads. One tag shows every Prebid auction, the revenue it brings, how fast your pages load for real readers and which articles earn the most, so you can see why revenue moved and what to fix.

This plugin adds the PubPerf tag to your WordPress site. Enter your website key once and data starts arriving in your PubPerf dashboard.

Prebid and header bidding analytics

Every bidder, every auction. Bid requests, responses, no-bids, timeouts, latency, win rate and eCPM for each bidder, by device, country and ad unit. Find the bidders that time out, slow your pages or never win.

Timeouts that cost you revenue. See how often each bidder misses your timeout, and how long the others take to answer.

Ad revenue

Revenue where it is earned. Revenue, RPM, impressions, eCPM and viewability by page, device and country, with header bidding and other demand side by side.

Page speed for real readers

Core Web Vitals. LCP, CLS and INP from your real readers, not a lab test, with the pages that need work and how they change over time.

Real user monitoring. Load times as your readers see them, from the first byte to the full page, and how fast your ads load.

Content that earns

Content analytics. Which authors, categories and articles bring readers and revenue, grouped automatically from your posts.

Know when something changes

Alerts. An email when revenue, speed or traffic changes, so you hear about a broken ad setup before the end of the month.

Your data, where you need it. Pull the daily Prebid report into Tableau, Looker Studio or a data warehouse with the Prebid Report API, or ask your AI assistant about your sites with the PubPerf MCP server.

Works with your site

PubPerf works alongside popular caching and speed plugins, such as WP Rocket, Autoptimize, LiteSpeed Cache and Cloudflare, and respects your readers’ consent choices under GDPR.

External services

This plugin connects your site to PubPerf, a service by Transfon Ltd, to build your analytics reports.

  • The PubPerf tag. When a website key is saved, every public page loads the PubPerf tag. It sends page views, page speed and Core Web Vitals timings, Prebid auction and ad events, and the page’s address, author, category and tags to PubPerf. Where GDPR applies and a consent management platform is used, it waits for the reader’s consent. Nothing is loaded until a website key is saved.
  • The admin pages. The plugin’s Home and Support tabs link to PubPerf’s dashboard and documentation; nothing is sent to PubPerf from WordPress itself.

Service provider: PubPerf. Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate the plugin from Plugins > Add New.
  2. Create a PubPerf account and add your site as a project.
  3. Copy the project’s website key from its install section.
  4. Open PubPerf Analytics in the admin menu, and on the Settings tab enter the website key and click Save Changes.
  5. On the Home tab, check that the PubPerf tag is loading. Data shows in your dashboard a few minutes after the first readers visit.
sections.faq:
Do I need a PubPerf account?

Yes. The plugin adds the PubPerf tag to your site; your reports are in your PubPerf dashboard. Every plan starts with a 14-day free trial.

Where do I find my website key?

In your PubPerf dashboard, open the project for this site. The website key is in its install section.

When will I see data?

A few minutes after readers visit your site with the tag loading. Daily reports, such as the Prebid report, are complete the next day.

Do I need Prebid?

No. Page speed, Core Web Vitals, real user monitoring and content analytics work on any site. Prebid and header bidding reports need Prebid.js on your pages, and ad revenue reports need Google Ad Manager or Prebid.

Does it work with caching and optimisation plugins?

Yes. PubPerf works with WP Rocket, Autoptimize, LiteSpeed Cache, Cloudflare and similar plugins, and measures your pages from the start.

Why are authors or categories missing in content analytics?

The plugin adds them for your posts automatically, and works alongside SEO plugins such as Yoast SEO, Rank Math and All in One SEO. If some are still missing, check that your posts have an author and category set, or contact us and we’ll take a look.

Does PubPerf respect consent?

Yes. Where GDPR applies and your site uses a consent management platform, PubPerf waits until the reader agrees to measurement before it collects anything. See consent support.

I have several sites.

Add each site as its own project in PubPerf, with its own website key, and install the plugin on each site. You see all of them together in your dashboard.

How much does PubPerf cost?

Plans start at $39 a month, and every plan starts with a 14-day free trial. See pricing.

Where can I get help?

See the documentation or email support@transfon.com.
sections.changelog:
2.3.1

  • Improved: a clearer plugin description and setup guide.

2.3.0

  • New: a Home tab that shows whether the tag is loading and links to each part of PubPerf.
  • New: adds each post’s author, category and tags to the page when no SEO plugin does, so content analytics groups articles correctly. This can be turned off.
  • New: works with caching and optimisation plugins such as WP Rocket, Autoptimize, LiteSpeed Cache and Cloudflare.
  • Fix: the website key is checked on save.
  • Fix: the plugin’s options are removed when it is deleted.
  • Updated pricing and support information.

2.2.1

  • UI refresh with clean, modern design.
  • Replaced emoji icons with inline SVG icons.
  • Improved toast notifications.
  • Tested up to WordPress 6.9.
  • Minimum PHP version is now 7.4.

2.1.0

  • New admin interface with Settings and Support tabs.
  • Settings save without reloading the page.
  • Added a FAQ section.

1.0.1

  • Version update.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
